specs.title: Frontend serves HTML at / with 200 OK
GraphQL health endpoint returns ok
Campaign Dashboard loads with empty state
Create Campaign validates empty name
Create Campaign with valid data succeeds
Campaign card shows name, description, status, date
Clicking a campaign navigates to detail page
Delete campaign removes it from list
Content list shows empty state initially
Create Content validates required headline
Create Content with valid headline+description succeeds
Content card shows headline, language tag, state badge
Content card can expand and show editable fields
Content card can save edited headline/description
Generate Draft button visible when content state is DRAFT
After successful generation, state changes to SUGGESTED_BY_AI
Generate Draft button hidden after state changes from DRAFT
Error state shown if AI generation fails
Approve/Reject/Request Edits buttons visible for SUGGESTED_BY_AI
Approve action changes state to APPROVED
Reject action with feedback changes state to REJECTED
Request Edits changes state to REVIEWED
Edit & Reset to Draft on REJECTED content
Review buttons hidden for APPROVED content
Translate button visible when content state is APPROVED
Language selector shows supported codes
Translate creates new content piece in the list
Translated piece has correct language tag
DRAFT state shows "Draft" badge
SUGGESTED_BY_AI state shows "Suggested" badge
REVIEWED state shows "Reviewed" badge
APPROVED state shows "Approved" badge
REJECTED state shows "Rejected" badge
Unknown/fallback state does not crash the page
Creating campaign with empty name shows validation error
Creating content with empty headline shows validation error
Deleting a campaign with no content succeeds
AI draft on non-existent content returns error
Review action on non-existent content returns error
State machine invalid transitions return errors
CSRF — GraphQL mutations work via frontend nginx proxy (no 403)
Enum case — state badges render without crash
Health check — backend responds to GraphQL without error
Connection indicator shows green when connected
State changes broadcast via WebSocket (toast notification)
Disconnecting and reconnecting shows connection state changes
